mapper.sql: service_bookings.id AS id, service_bookings.public_id AS publicId, client_accounts.display_name AS clientName, client_accounts.phone AS clientPhone, service_bookings.service_name AS serviceName, service_bookings.note AS note, service_bookings.agreed_price AS agreedPrice, service_bookings.payment_status AS paymentStatus, service_bookings.created_by_name AS createdByName, service_bookings.confirmed_by_name AS confirmedByName, service_bookings.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, service_bookings.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_bookings INNER JOIN client_accounts ON client_accounts.id=service_bookings.client_account_id WHERE service_bookings.store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY service_bookings.created_at DESC, service_bookings.id DESC
SELECT FROM service_bookings INNER JOIN client_accounts ON client_accounts.id=service_bookings.client_account_id WHERE service_bookings.store_id=#{storeId} AND service_bookings.public_id=#{publicId}
SELECT id, public_id AS publicId, client_account_id AS clientAccountId, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM service_bookings WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND public_id=#{publicId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM client_accounts WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND phone=#{phone}
mapper.update: UPDATE client_accounts SET display_name=#{name} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE service_bookings SET service_name=#{serviceName}, note=#{note}, agreed_price=#{agreedPrice} WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status IN ('PAY_LATER','PENDING')
UPDATE service_bookings SET payment_status='PAID', confirmed_by_account_id=#{accountId}, confirmed_by_name=#{name}, confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status='PENDING'
UPDATE service_bookings SET payment_status='CANCELLED' WHERE id=#{id} AND payment_status IN ('PAY_LATER','PENDING')
